problems.label: The Postdoc Vanishing Act
problems.body: Key postdoc left the lab. Pipeline gone with them. Nobody knows how the figures were made.

problems.label: Hard Drive of Doom
problems.body: Three years of data. One dead hard drive. No backups. A moment of silence.

problems.label: Package Update Chaos
problems.body: Updated R/Python. Everything broke. The analysis that ran fine last week now crashes with 47 errors.

problems.label: Reviewer Wants Reanalysis
problems.body: "Please repeat the analysis excluding outliers." ...which analysis? Which parameters? What year was this?

problems.label: The Undocumented Inheritance
problems.body: Inherited a pile of scripts from a previous student. No comments. No README. Variable names: df2, df2b, df2b_final_FINAL.

problems.label: Six-Month Amnesia
problems.body: Opened your own analysis notebook from six months ago. May as well be ancient Sanskrit.

problems.label: Collaborator Can't Run It
problems.body: Sent your pipeline to a collaborator. Works on your machine. Spectacularly fails on theirs.

problems.label: Figure Doesn't Match Paper
problems.body: Revision round 3. The figure in the draft doesn't match what the methods say. Which is right?

problems.label: The Bug Time Bomb
problems.body: Found a bug in the analysis script. How many results are affected? How far back does this go? No idea.

problems.label: Grant Renewal Nightmare
problems.body: Five years later, grant renewal time. "We will build on our previous results." ...can you reproduce them?

solutions.label: Version Control (Git)
solutions.body: Track every change to every file. Who changed what, when, and why. Time-travel for your code.

solutions.label: Reproducible Environments
solutions.body: Lock your software stack so it works anywhere, any time. No more "works on my machine."

solutions.label: Literate Analysis
solutions.body: Code + prose + output in one living document. The analysis explains itself as it runs.

solutions.label: Raw Data is Sacred
solutions.body: Never overwrite raw data. Ever. Scripts transform it; they don't eat it. Treat originals as read-only.

solutions.label: Workflow Managers
solutions.body: Define your pipeline as code. Automatic re-runs, provenance tracking, HPC-ready.

solutions.label: README + Comments (the WHY)
solutions.body: Don't document what the code does — document why. Future you will weep with gratitude.

solutions.label: Automated Backups + Cloud
solutions.body: The 3-2-1 rule: 3 copies, 2 media types, 1 offsite. Automate it. Never think about it again.

solutions.label: Archive at Publication
solutions.body: At submission: tag the release, deposit data + code, get a DOI. Permanent, citable, done.

benefits.label: Your Work is Verifiable
benefits.body: Anyone can check your numbers. That's not scary — that's the whole point of science.

benefits.label: Science Builds on Solid Foundations
benefits.body: When your work is reproducible, others can extend it rather than spend months just replicating it.

benefits.label: You Save Time Long-Term
benefits.body: The upfront investment pays back massively. Future projects, future resubmissions, future you.

benefits.label: Frictionless Collaboration
benefits.body: Hand off work, onboard students, or partner with remote labs without the usual chaos.

benefits.label: Your Future Self Thanks You
benefits.body: Six months from now, you will open this project and actually understand what's going on. Miraculous.

benefits.label: Errors Get Caught Early
benefits.body: Version control and provenance tracking mean bugs surface fast and their blast radius is known.

benefits.label: Your Work Has Lasting Impact
benefits.body: Papers with accessible data and code get cited more. Reproducible science outlives its authors.
